new_findings.input: Tree /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-auth-gap/9d8a4d2c-1b03-53cb-ba04-44a67affb095/scratchpad/d64recheck/U09/x/n4. pkg/__init__.py is empty. pkg/config.py: `MODE = "a"`. pkg/b.py: `from pkg.c import *`. pkg/c.py: `from pkg.b import *` / `from pkg import config`. pkg/aaa.py: `from pkg.c import *` / `X = 1`, which is unrelated to anything else. pkg/admin.py: `from pkg.b import *` / `def set_mode(v): config.MODE = v`. pkg/server.py: `from . import config`, and the tool (destructiveHint=False) calls `open(path, config.MODE)`. In CPython, pkg.config.MODE is 'w' after admin.set_mode('w'). Control n4c is the same tree without aaa.py.
new_findings.observed: Fixed version: n4 gives FS_WRITE fs_mode=a / destructive=False with no D2 note (内). n4c gives D2 矛 (fs_unknown_model_path). A trace of _star_exports shows that in n4, pkg.aaa's star import computes _star_exports('pkg.c') first. The inner _star_exports('pkg.b') then gets {} from the cycle guard `cache[module] = {}` for pkg.c, which is still being computed, and that partial result stays cached as the final value for pkg.b ('pkg.b -> {}'). So admin's `from pkg.b import *` never picks up the alias config, and `config.MODE = v` is missed. The version before the fix gives 内 for both trees.
new_findings.expected: admin's config is the pkg.config module, brought in through pkg.b's star import. MODE should stay opaque and D2 should be 矛, whether or not an unrelated file (aaa.py) is present or where it sorts in file order.
new_findings.plausibility: Low. It needs two modules that star-import each other, plus a star import of the cycle that sorts earlier in file order. But the verdict flips just from adding an unrelated file, so the result depends on which files are in the tree.
new_findings.proposed_fix: Do not cache results that were computed while the cycle guard was active. Alternatively, have _star_exports collect every module reachable through star imports with a visited set local to the call, then add up the names over all of them, and cache only that complete result. If a cycle is found, treat the star import as bringing in every in-tree module name (take too many).

summary:
All five findings closed. I ran the review's own repro trees (t1, t3, t4, t6, t6b, t9, t10) with the fix (the c6ca5cc worktree) and with the version before it (e9afc10, extracted to scratch). A1 to A3 go from 内 to D2 矛; A4 (a) goes from 内 to D2 不; A4 (b) and A5 no longer produce the false D1 row. The U09 test files (test_d64_u09_advrev.py and test_d64_u09_module_values.py) all pass.

To look for new errors, I compared effect and row output between the two versions on the 14 calibration trees (A1–A18) and 57 real corpus trees (prev / prev5 with 3–120 .py files). No unit, effect or row changed. The new check _enclosing_binds never returned True just because a node was missing from its parent map (0 times).

I found one new error the fix introduced (U09-R1, false_clean, low plausibility). When two modules star-import each other, the loop guard in the new _star_exports saves a half-finished result for good. Adding one unrelated file that star-imports the cycle then turns the tree's D2 verdict from 矛 into 内. Confirmed on tree n4 against control n4c, with a trace of _star_exports and a CPython check that MODE really becomes 'w'.

Other variants I tried did not break: the dotted-chain write through a function-local import (n2) and a namespace package (n1). Separately, U09-R2 records that the mixin-order mistake behind A5 is still present when the attribute is read through an instance (`Backend().store` / `self.store`). It was already there before this fix (introduced_by_fix=false).

The implementer disclosed that some effect rows now disappear (A4 (b), A5). A third path does the same: in `_ev_Name`, a nested function now gets no type when an outer function rebinds the name with an import, def or class. When the outer function binds it with a parameter, the result is the same as before (checked in r1).

I did not change any files. Work trees and scripts are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-auth-gap/9d8a4d2c-1b03-53cb-ba04-44a67affb095/scratchpad/d64recheck/U09/: run.sh, dump.py, cmp.py and probe_star.py, the test trees under x/, and the before/after outputs P_*.json and A_*.json.
